throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: setx86loope $r12, $r4; setx86loope $r13, $r5; setx86loope $r14, $r6; setx86loope $r15, $r7; setx86loope $r16, $r8; setx86loope $r17, $r9; setx86loope $r18, $r10; setx86loope $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0' --asm 'setx86loope $r12, $r4; setx86loope $r13, $r5; setx86loope $r14, $r6; setx86loope $r15, $r7; setx86loope $r16, $r8; setx86loope $r17, $r9; setx86loope $r18, $r10; setx86loope $r19, $r11'

notes: LBT instruction. Latency is recorded for the rj counter path and the EFLAGS path.
